mapping.instructions: Map instructions.md once without duplicating policy text.
mapping.context: Map canonical references and freshness rules.
mapping.skills: Project shared SKILL.md capabilities without expanding Agent authority.
mapping.tools: Generate the runtime allowlist and typed Tool contracts.
mapping.approvals: Enforce approval gates outside the model prompt.
mapping.output_schema: Enforce structured success and failure outputs.
mapping.limits: Enforce session, turn, Tool, timeout, parallelism, and cost limits.
mapping.telemetry: Emit redacted traces and version metadata under the data policy.

controls.approval_enforcement: Fail closed before protected calls or commits.
controls.schema_enforcement: Validate Tool inputs and Agent outputs at runtime.
controls.limit_enforcement: Abort safely at configured resource ceilings.
controls.drift_detection: Compare generated artifact hashes with the Release tuple.
